title: Before the Backtest: Pre-Freeze Common-Support Ceilings for Event-Driven Strategy Research
description: A pre-freeze common-support ceiling: compute the maximum attainable matched support on the complete point-in-time eligible population, before a matched event-study design is frozen and before any outcome column is opened; stop if the implied confirmatory sample falls below a pre-registered minimum. Demonstrated on 62 candidate cryptocurrency delisting events: implied confirmatory sample 10 against a required 40, with no price column loaded at any point. Scientific content accepted at version V4.
